alt: A short film with no voice. A pink entryway with a door that has a paper wanted notice on it. A small cobalt block figure with white eyes nudges a lidless plastic food container a little toward the door, knocks, and waits with wide eyes. The door opens; an ink-black figure behind it smiles and tosses a blue lid, which lands right on the container. They both pulse with happy eyes and lean toward each other. The text stays: wanted: whoever still has my tupperware since March.
